spans.s: indirā, f. epithet of Lakṣmī.
indra-ya, den. Ā. long for Indra.
indra-yú, a. longing for Indra.
índrā-vat, a. accompanied by Indra.
indra‿agní, m. du. Indra and Agni.
indrāṇī́, f. Indraʼs wife.
indra‿anuja, m. Indraʼs younger 🞄brother (Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa).
índrā-pū́ṣan (or indrā-pūṣán), 🞄m. du. Indra and Pūṣan.
índrā-váruṇa, m. du. Indra and 🞄Varuṇa.

indriya‿artha, m. object or stimulant 🞄of the senses;
 -asaṅga, m. pl. non-indulgence 🞄of the senses.
índra‿iṣita, pp. sent or urged by 🞄Indra.
indra‿utsava, m. festival in honour 🞄of Indra.
